title: V3B2 and last dev : Missing BG dots on the graph
body:
It happened with V3B2 and in the last dev.
![Screenshot_20211101-192842_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/139722172-e7c9fcb3-e6a6-4ad3-b1c7-3eb5e13b293c.jpg)

Sometimes, the left side of the graph has no BG points and then they appear next time I look at them... No idea what is the cause...

![Screenshot_20211030-175617_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/139722386-2f73328f-254c-499a-abcb-b14556a48f5f.jpg)
![Screenshot_20211101-192558_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/139722429-4f89cbe5-7d08-4bf9-9aad-2939aaf24bae.jpg)

comments.body: Do you see that after a long press on graph to change time range or at any moment (without doing anything else) ?
No, I do nothing specific. I tap the AAPS icon to bring it forward and the dots are missing. I close it and open it several minutes later and the dots are there...

Confirmed.

For me, it was fixed after a few long press to the graph until comming back to the wanted time range.

This issue still happens. 

Most of the time it works fine, but rarely it happens.

It was self fixed in active overview after 10 - 20 seconds. I think AAPS is loading data in that time.
